blocks.label: introduction-section
content: name: tarav-hugentics

description: "Run Tarav's User Brief, Project.Wiki capture, Product.Surface Breadcrumb capture, Model capture, Reading Club, Issue, Design Dialogue, Design Impact, and implementation workflows. USE WHEN the user wants a first-principles briefing linked to their past conversations, a User-Turn-grounded project wiki or product surface, dialogue capture, Model capture, a Reading Project, Issue work, assessment of recent in-chat design's implementation impact, implementation design or execution, or invokes `tarav-hugentics --user-brief` (`--brief`), `--capture`, `--reading-club`, `--issues`, `--design --dialogue --wiki`, `--design --impact`, or `--impl`."
# Tarav Hugentics
`tarav-hugentics` is Tarav's public User Brief, conversational capture, Reading
Club, Design Dialogue, Design Impact, and implementation surface. It preserves the Hugentics alignment
workflows while using Chatlas and the Tarav.Diagram as its User-Touched
indexing backend.
Before operating, read the Tarav Constitution at
[`../tarav-pkg/CONSTITUTION.md`](../tarav-pkg/CONSTITUTION.md). Capture must
remain writable, evidence-linked, and nonblocking in the presence of POIs.

blocks.label: batchy-skill-contract
content: ## Batchy.Skill Contract
Treat the skill call like a command line:
- explicit flags win over conversational inference;
- a trailing value is the selected workflow's focus or input;
- `-h` or `--help` prints the command surface and stops;
- ask rather than guess when the requested route remains materially ambiguous;
- flags select workflow behavior; they are not forwarded to the Tarav CLI.

blocks.label: command-surface
content: ## Command Surface
```text
tarav-hugentics --user-brief [TOPIC]
tarav-hugentics --brief [TOPIC]
Brief the User on any topic: find what the User last discussed about it,
then explain it from first principles. Read-only.
tarav-hugentics --capture [PROMPT]
Interactive reviewed capture. Initial stance: Review.
tarav-hugentics --capture --auto [PROMPT]
tarav-hugentics --capture --unreviewed [PROMPT]
Equivalent one-trigger unreviewed routes; the invocation authorizes one
bounded capture pass and its landing.
tarav-hugentics --capture --audit [PROMPT]
Read-only contextualization and Capture.Roadmap.
tarav-hugentics --capture --wiki [FOCUS]
Capture the current discussion into the Project.Wiki. Always update the
daily narrative and integrate topical Notes when useful.
tarav-hugentics --capture --wiki --target <WIKI_NOTE> [FOCUS]
Use one explicit topical Note inside the Project.Wiki while retaining the
mandatory daily capture.
tarav-hugentics --capture --wiki --audit <WIKI_NOTE>
Audit one Note's embedded Breadcrumbs without mutation.
tarav-hugentics --capture --inline <SURFACE>
Attach selected Chatlas User Turns through opaque Breadcrumb labels in one
Product.Surface.
tarav-hugentics --capture --inline --audit <SURFACE>
Audit one surface's Breadcrumb positions and typed attachments without
mutation.
tarav-hugentics --commit [PATH...]
Create evidence-backed Git commits for current changes without requiring a
Tarav Project.
tarav-hugentics --reading-club [DOCUMENT]
Start or resume an Agent-operated Reading.Project and coordinate its
in-chat Present → Read → Discuss → Capture → Advance loop.
tarav-hugentics --issues [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --issue [INPUT]
Work with Issue.Blocks. New material defaults to the short Parking
workflow; an existing Issue defaults to maintenance.
tarav-hugentics --issues --park [INPUT]
Explicitly select the Parking workflow.
tarav-hugentics --issues --audit [QUERY]
Inspect relevant Issue.Blocks and their POIs without mutation.
tarav-hugentics --design --dialogue --wiki [FOCUS]
Capture the discussion as a condensed dialogue in a named Wiki dialogs/
Note, appending a dated section with Breadcrumbs and a daily link.
tarav-hugentics --design --impact [INPUT]
Evaluate the implementation impact of recent design work in the current
chat. INPUT optionally narrows the focus; this is assessment only.
tarav-hugentics --impl [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --impl --design [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --impl-design [INPUT]
Design an implementation and produce its live-note Impl.Req. Bare --impl
defaults here for actionable input that is not already an Impl.Req.
tarav-hugentics --impl --review <IMPL_REQ>
tarav-hugentics --review <IMPL_REQ>
Cold, read-only readiness and evidence review.
tarav-hugentics --impl --execute <IMPL_REQ|INPUT>
tarav-hugentics --execute <IMPL_REQ|INPUT>
tarav-hugentics --exec <IMPL_REQ|INPUT>
Execute an existing Impl.Req. Explicit Execute with direct input first
bootstraps its Impl.Req surfaces through ordinary capture.
tarav-hugentics --impl --develop [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --impl --dev [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --develop [INPUT]
tarav-hugentics --dev [INPUT]
Design the durable Impl.Req, cold-reload it, then execute it.
tarav-hugentics --impl --harvest [PROMPT]
tarav-hugentics --impl-harvest [PROMPT]
Select one ready implementation unit from mixed discussion and Develop it.
tarav-hugentics --impl --capture
tarav-hugentics --impl-capture
Compose implementation capture behavior with the selected mutating
implementation workflow; this is not an independent implementation phase.
tarav-hugentics --impl --impact [FOCUS]
tarav-hugentics --impl --design --impact [FOCUS]
Assess recent in-chat design against current code, then use the actionable
delta as input to implementation Design. Bare --impl defaults to Design.
tarav-hugentics --impl --dev --impact [FOCUS]
tarav-hugentics --impl --develop --impact [FOCUS]
Use that same delta as input to Develop: design, then implement.
`--auto` and `--unreviewed` are aliases only within `--capture`. They omit both
per-Line review and a separate landing checkpoint: the initial User trigger
covers the bounded pass. They do not weaken support, producer, validation, or
POI requirements. `--audit` conflicts with either unreviewed-capture flag
because audit is read-only.
Within `--capture --wiki`, `--target` selects an optional topical destination
inside the Project.Wiki and does not suppress the daily capture. It does not
define another workflow. `--audit` selects the read-only audit route, requires
exactly one wiki Note, and does not compose with `--auto` or `--unreviewed`. A
successful ordinary Wiki capture closes the complete Project.Wiki with a Git
commit; the invocation authorizes that commit.
Within `--capture --inline`, ordinary capture may mutate exactly one selected
surface and must submit provisional markers through the `chatlas-context`
Breadcrumb workflow using its supported native convention. Composing workflows
reuse the same complete path for each Product.Surface they are authorized to
modify. `--audit` is read-only and checks retained positions and typed
attachments.
Within `--impl`, `--auto` or `--autonomous` selects autonomous alignment at
declared checkpoints. It does not change Diagram support requirements or turn
Agent-generated coordination material into User-Touched data.
`--reading-club` selects its own workflow and does not compose with Capture,
Issue, or implementation routes. Its optional trailing value is a document,
project slug, title fragment, or other practical navigation hint; Agents
resolve equivalence from context rather than fingerprints.
Implementation contextualizes through the Project.Wiki; `--wiki` is optional
and does not select a phase. Examples: `--impl --wiki [INPUT]`,
`--impl --wiki --design [INPUT]`, `--impl --wiki --execute <IMPL_REQ|INPUT>`,
`--impl --wiki --develop [INPUT]`, and `--impl --wiki --review <IMPL_REQ>`.
The Model-backed route and its `--model` selector are parked.

blocks.label: routing
content: ## Routing
An explicit `--commit` loads [`references/commit-evidence.md`](references/commit-evidence.md) and stops ordinary Capture and
implementation routing. It needs Git repositories, not a Tarav Project.
`--design --dialogue --wiki` loads [`references/design-dialogue.md`](references/design-dialogue.md) and captures the
conversation as a dialogue. Select this route before implementation routing.
It does not create an Impl.Req or select an implementation phase.
Implementation phases live in
[`references/impl/phases.md`](references/impl/phases.md) and read context from
a context backend; the Project.Wiki is the only active one. The Model backend
is parked: `--model` and legacy notes carrying Impl.Req.Diagram require
clarification before any mutation; never silently migrate a request.
Do not reread a skill `references/` file that was already read completely and
remains available in context. Reread it only if it changed, its contents were
lost or materially reduced through compaction, or a specific uncertainty
requires it.
`--impact` selects input: the implementation delta implied by recent in-chat
design, optionally narrowed by FOCUS. It does not select an implementation
phase. Without an implementation selector, `--design --impact` follows
{{skw:link-0}} and reports only.
With `--impl` or an explicit implementation selector such as `--dev`, route
through [`references/impl.md`](references/impl.md), which uses the same
assessment before running the selected workflow. Thus `--impl --design
--impact` is implementation Design, not the read-only report route.
Bare `--design` does not select Design Impact. Standalone Design Impact does
not compose with Capture; implementation routes retain their ordinary capture
contract.
`--user-brief` and its shortcut `--brief` load and follow [`references/user-brief.md`](references/user-brief.md).
User Brief is read-only and does not compose with Capture or implementation.
Ordinary Capture routes load and follow [`references/capture.md`](references/capture.md).
`--capture --wiki`, including its `--target` and `--audit` routes, instead
loads and follows [`references/wiki-capture.md`](references/wiki-capture.md).
It edits Project.Wiki Markdown only in the ordinary non-audit route and never
enters Diagram Model capture.
`--capture --inline`, including its `--audit` route, loads and follows
[`references/inline-capture.md`](references/inline-capture.md).
Reading Club routes load and follow
[`references/reading-club.md`](references/reading-club.md).
Issue routes first load [`references/issues.md`](references/issues.md), which
selects one Issue workflow without creating a separate Parking.Note object.
Implementation routes first load
[`references/impl.md`](references/impl.md), which selects exactly one
implementation workflow module. Without an explicit route, infer capture,
Issue, or implementation only when the conversational request is clear.
The runtime commands `::discuss`, `::review`, `::approve <token>`, `::land`,
and `::land-all-approved` belong to the running Capture workflow. Reading
navigation commands such as `::forward`, `::backward`, `::capture`, and
`::annotate`, together with reading commands such as `::narrate`, belong to a
running Reading Club workflow. They are not initial Batchy.Skill calls.

blocks.label: boundary
content: ## Boundary
This fresh skill does not use the legacy Markdown Index, Anchory, Agendix, or
Chat.Index backpropagation mechanics. Those are Attic evidence. Current
User-Touched index output is the target Diagram Namespace's typed Ship database
and separate Annotation claims; implementation live notes remain separate
Product.Surfaces.
Implementation follows the Wiki-backed live-note and Wiki capture contract.
The former Model-backed implementation route, with its `Impl.Req.Collection`,
`Diagram.Draft`, and implementation `Capture.Authorization.Gate`, is parked;
absent Model artifacts are not POIs for implementation.
